name: Jordan's Smithing Hammer
summary: Jordan Stilwell waits outside Ironforge for his father's hammer, lost within Shadowfang Keep.

sections.title: A Craftsman's Legacy
sections.body: Jordan Stilwell is a human blacksmith who works outside Ironforge. His father’s hammer lies within Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest. Without it, Jordan cannot forge a sacred weapon fit for a holy champion, the masterwork he hopes to make.

faq.q: Where is Jordan's Smithing Hammer located?
aliases: where to find jordan's smithing hammer
faq.answer: Jordan's Smithing Hammer lies inside Shadowfang Keep in the forests of Silverpine. Paladins taking the Test of Righteousness must enter the occupied fortress to recover it.

faq.q: Why is this hammer so important to Jordan Stilwell?
aliases: why does jordan want the hammer
faq.answer: Jordan inherited the hammer from his father, and it means much to him. He needs it to forge his finest work, a holy weapon consecrated to the Light.

faq.q: What is the hammer used for once recovered?
faq.answer: Bring the hammer to Jordan outside the gates of Ironforge with lumber, ore, and a gem. He will forge a sacred armament for the paladin who helped him.

angles.text: As a paladin, you must venture into perilous lands to retrieve the heirloom hammer and prove your resolve in the trials of righteousness.
As a blacksmith, you know the bond between a master smith and a hammer passed down by their forebears.
